name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd
title: Indian Hotels Company Ltd - 500850 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hotel operator guides FY27 double-digit revenue growth of 12-14% and sees tight supply, but West Asia disruption cut ~INR40-50 crore consol revenue and April was weak. Mostly demand and asset-light narrative, with no capacity-cut signal.

utilisation.quote: you still manage 78% occupancy and 8% RevPAR growth for FY '26

capex.quote: we will continue to invest INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores annually to strengthen our existing competitive advantages

triggers.label: Tight supply outlook for RevPAR
triggers.quote: we feel reasonably certain that this is going to be a tight supply situation, at least for the reasonable future

triggers.label: April weak, then strong growth
triggers.quote: March was a difficult month. Beginning of April was difficult. Middle of April came the stability. Since then, we are seeing strong growth

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 12-14%
triggers.quote: We remain fairly confident that we will again deliver double -digit growth between 12%, let's say, and 14%

guidance.quote: We remain fairly confident that we will again deliver double -digit growth between 12%, let's say, and 14%
in FY '27, we expect 60 -plus hotel openings across brands and geographies
high single digits, let's say, anywhere starting from 7-ish going up 8%, 9%
we will continue to invest INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores annually
We think we should be above 12% for the quarter.

red_flags.quote: impact after the West Asia conflict in the global market. So, we did see some loss of revenues in some of our hotels internationally, including London
